title: Household Add-On Membership: household add-on cap and per-tier discount rates
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the maximum number of that add-on a primary member may hold open at once, the sibling discount rate applied to each additional dependent add-on beyond the primary member's first, the number of concurrently open add-ons that qualifies the household for the multi-add-on bundle rate, the bundle discount rate itself, and the additional senior-parent discount rate.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Maximum open at once per primary (a value of 0 means unlimited) | Sibling discount rate | Household multi-add-on minimum count | Household multi-add-on bundle discount rate | Senior-parent additional discount rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | 0, unlimited | 0 percent | 3 | 10 percent | not applicable |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | 0, unlimited | 0 percent | 3 | 10 percent | not applicable |
| Dependent Child Add-On | 0, unlimited | 15 percent | 3 | 10 percent | not applicable |
| Young Adult Add-On | 0, unlimited | 10 percent | 3 | 10 percent | not applicable |
| Senior Parent Add-On | 0, unlimited | 0 percent | 3 | 10 percent | 15 percent |
| Household Multi-Add-On | 0, unlimited | 15 percent | 3 | 15 percent | not applicable |

## Points of judgement
- Every current tier's maximum number of that add-on open at once per primary member reads 0, meaning no tier today caps how many of that add-on a primary member may hold; the cap is nonetheless set per tier, so a future tier could carry a nonzero cap while every other tier stays unlimited.
- The Spouse Add-On, the Domestic Partner Add-On and the Senior Parent Add-On carry no sibling discount rate on an additional dependent add-on of that same tier; the Dependent Child Add-On, the Young Adult Add-On and the Household Multi-Add-On do.
- Every tier's household multi-add-on minimum count reads 3, and every tier but the Household Multi-Add-On sets its own bundle discount rate at 10 percent; the Household Multi-Add-On sets its bundle discount rate higher, at 15 percent.
- Only the Senior Parent Add-On carries an additional senior-parent discount rate; no other tier carries one.
